They are native to the [[Snow Realm]] of [[Hyrule]]. Their mist prevents them from being attacked directly as it will freeze [[Link]] instantly, requiring the screen to be rubbed with the stylus to thaw him out. Like [[Yellow ChuChu|Yellow Chuchus]], they can be stunned first to remove their defense mechanism, rendering them safe to attack. ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract|Ice Chuchu}} Ice Chuchus appear in more frigid climates, such as [[Mount Hylia]] and the [[Hebra Mountains]]. They are lightweight and can be pushed about with gusts of wind from the [[Korok Leaf]]. If they touch [[Link]], he becomes temporarily frozen due to the frigid air they emit. Ice Chuchus attack by leaping at Link and creating an icy blast around them. After attacking, Ice Chuchus temporarily lose their icy coating and are vulnerable to attack. If they are defeated while they have their icy exteriors, they will explode into a cloud of frost, freezing anything in range. Ice Chuchus drop [[White Chuchu Jelly|White Chuchu Jellies]] upon their defeat. ====Drops==== {{Collapsible |header= Drops of Ice Chuchu (small) |collapse= true |content= {{Tabs |- | Normal | {{Drop Table |game= BotW |- | White Chuchu Jelly | 1 | 100 % |- | White Chuchu Jelly | 1
| 60 % }} }} }} {{Collapsible |header= Drops of Ice Chuchu (middle) |collapse= true |content= {{Tabs |- | Normal | {{Drop Table |game= BotW |- | White Chuchu Jelly | 2 | 100 % |- | White Chuchu Jelly | 1-2 | 60 % }} }} }} {{Collapsible |header= Drops of Ice Chuchu (large) |collapse= true |content= {{Tabs |- | Normal | {{Drop Table |game= BotW |- | White Chuchu Jelly | 3 | 100 % |- | White Chuchu Jelly | 2-3 | 80 % }} }} }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Ice Chuchu}} {{Stub|TotK}} Ice Chuchus in {{TotK}} can, once again, be found in snowy regions. They emit frigid air that temporarily freezes [[Link]] if he touches them. Ice Chuchus attack by leaping at Link and creating bursts of frost that freeze anything caught in them. They are temporarily thawed after attacking, allowing Link to safely strike them. When defeated with their icy coatings active, they explode into a cold mist that freezes anything nearby. When defeated, Ice Chuchus drop [[White Chuchu Jelly|White Chuchu Jellies]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Ice Chuchus reappear in {{AoC}}, first appearing in [[Revali, the Rito Warrior]]. They act the same as in {{BotW|-}}, and once again drop [[White Chuchu Jelly]] upon defeat. The giant variants make a reappearance during the {{PotA}} [[Downloadable Content]] missions, attacking by rolling into the player, spinning around, slamming down into the ground, and firing off small Ice Chuchus. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Enemies |category= Enemies in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * The Enemy's behavior * The Enemy's weaknesses }} {{Stub|AoI}} Ice Chuchus appear as regular [[Enemy|Enemies]] in [[Battle]]s taking place on the [[Tabantha Frontier]].
